hook: Your phone's white screen is secretly three colours.
title: Your White Screen Isn't Really White
description:
Put a small drop of water on a white phone screen and film it up close. The drop acts like a tiny magnifier and shows the red, green and blue lights that make up every pixel. Wipe the screen dry afterwards.

#Shorts #PhoneTricks #Tech
comment_prompt: Did you see the colours? Yes or no
